title: dendranthema indicum var. acutum
intro: Dendranthema indicum var. acutum, commonly known as White Chrysanthemum or Yulan, is a plant species in the Asteraceae family. It is traditionally used in Chinese medicine to treat various health conditions, such as fever, headache, and digestive issues, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of White Chrysanthemum include anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its use in treating respiratory and cardiovascular diseases. The plant's bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, triterpenoids, and phenolic acids, are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
